messages:
maria: Quick flag from onboarding: Node vs Python sampleapp give different embedding dims for same model. Node -> 1536, Python -> 768.

liam: Model name? envs?

maria: MODEL=embed-kuiper-v1 in both. Node curl -> service returns 1536. Python wrapper shows 768.

sophie: Can you paste the Python parse code? Might be mapping field names or a quantization shim.

maria: Python: `resp.data[0].vector` prints len 768. Raw curl shows `.data[0].embedding | length` = 1536.

sam: Been a known auth/retry hazard: token refresh retryed against fallback model. Check request logs for 401+retry.

paul: Also check batching helper: if it resends overlapping batches without idempotency, server dedupe can collapse results.

sophie: Action items: (1) add strict dim assert in sampleapp (env toggle), (2) add idempotency header to batching-helper, (3) show curl dim check in quickstart. I'll open PRs.

doc-bot: created docs/pr-1337 preview link -> /preview/pr-1337

maria: thanks all, filing DX bug and will paste link when ready.
